nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: So the old dungeons are open again... I have unsealed the door for you. Whatever drove those rats to the surface, the answer lies below. Be careful down there.

actions.value: The dungeon door beneath the cellar is now open.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: A sealed stone door with old markings, you say? That must be the entrance to the dungeons beneath the village.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: Long before this village was built, there were tunnels below. They were sealed generations ago when something foul moved in. If the rats came up from there, the seal must be broken.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: I know the old unsealing rite. Give me a moment... there. The door should yield to you now. I will send word to the guard -- he will let you back into the hut.

actions.value: The Sage performs an ancient rite. The dungeon door is unsealed.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: Have you found anything in the cellar? Look carefully -- the rats must have come from somewhere deeper.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: The amulet is safe, and I thank you. But something still troubles me. That many rats do not infest a place without reason. Something drove them up from below.

choices.text: You want me to go back in there?
I am sure it was nothing.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: I would not ask if I were not worried. Return to the hut and search the cellar for whatever drove the rats to the surface. There may be a passage we never knew about. I will tell the guard to let you through again.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: Thank you. The guard will have my word by the time you reach the hut. Look for anything unusual -- a crack in the wall, a hidden passage, anything.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: I understand. But if you change your mind, I will be here. I cannot shake this feeling that something worse is lurking below.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: You found it! I can feel its power from here.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: Thank you! The village owes you a great debt. Let me mend your wounds as thanks.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: The rats grow bolder by the hour. Please, the hut is to the east -- the guard will let you through. Clear those vermin and find my amulet!

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: Thank goodness, a traveler with a sword arm! The governor called me to investigate a terrible rat infestation in the old hut to the east. But I am a scholar, not a swordsman -- the beasts nearly took my hand off when I went in.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: The rats stole my amulet of protection when I entered the hut. Dragged it down into the cellar below. I need someone who can fight to clear them out and bring it back. Will you help?

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: Bless you! The governor posted a guard at the hut door to keep people out. Tell him I sent you and he will let you through. Clear those rats and bring back my amulet.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: I understand. But without that amulet, the village has no protection. If you change your mind, I will be here.
